module_summary: Sequential 16x16 shift-and-add multiplier: a 3-state FSM loads operands, adds the shifting multiplicand into an accumulator for 16 cycles, then pulses done.

anchors.name: m
anchors.why: Idle/run/finish controller; gates operand load, accumulate steps and done pulse.

anchors.name: s
anchors.why: Start input loading operands and entering run state from idle.

anchors.name: p
anchors.why: Product output, direct copy of accumulator acc.

anchors.name: d
anchors.why: One-cycle done pulse in finish state accompanying the product.

anchors.name: t
anchors.why: Conditional add acc+x selected by y[0]; next accumulator value.

anchors.name: x
anchors.why: Multiplicand register shifted left each run cycle, added into acc.

anchors.name: y
anchors.why: Multiplier register shifted right; LSB selects whether to add.

anchors.name: k
anchors.why: Step counter incremented each run cycle; reaching 16 ends run.

anchors.name: z
anchors.why: Terminal-count flag moving FSM from run to finish.

anchors.name: bz
anchors.why: Busy level decoded from run state.

groups.name: mul_controller
groups.description: Start/run/finish FSM producing busy level and done pulse.

groups.name: shift_add_datapath
groups.description: Shifting operand registers and adder updating the accumulator/product.
